collection.title: Renault Megane Saloon 2003 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Renault Megane Saloon 2003 to 2006 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
